goal: Extract typed fields from semicolon-delimited text lines into a closed schema, rejecting anything that does not actually satisfy the declared type of each field.

acceptance.statement: A record is only considered valid when its 'active' field is an actual boolean, not the raw string 'true' or 'false'.
A text body that contains only headers or comments and no parsable record yields an explicit empty result, never a silently accepted record set.
